name: National University of Singapore
summary: Singapore's Kent Ridge university with 60 majors, 54 second majors and over 80 minors; May IB sitters apply on predicted grades.

ib.text: Open to IB Diploma holders of any nationality; English must be one of your IB subjects. May 2027 sitters apply on school-attested predicted results and NUS must receive the IB transcript by 6 July 2027.

dates.label: May 2027 IB sitters: update your IB Personal Code in the applicant portal
May 2027 IB sitters: NUS must have received your IB transcript

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: A project-based computing degree with a wide spread of electives, from big data and full-stack software engineering to artificial intelligence and robotics; double degrees, double majors and minors are open to you.
programmes.ib: NUS lists a pass in HL Computer Science, HL Maths AA or HL Physics, or a good pass in SL Maths AA or HL Maths AI. Check the current prerequisite list.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of predicted IB results, non-academic achievements and any interview or test; no IB grade profile is quoted here.

flagshipSource.title: NUS Computing: Computer Science, a project-based programme with electives across many sub-areas

faculties.name: Computing
faculties.line: Computer Science and related degrees; a strong maths base is expected, checked against the IB prerequisite list.

faculties.name: Design and Engineering
faculties.line: Engineering, Architecture, Industrial Design and Landscape Architecture; prerequisites vary by programme.

faculties.name: Business
faculties.line: Business Administration; prerequisites and any interview or test are set by the programme.

faculties.name: Medicine
faculties.line: Predicted IB results plus a UCAT, or SAT/ACT with Writing and AP exams, by the same closing date as other IB applicants.

faculties.name: Dentistry
faculties.line: Predicted IB results plus SAT/ACT with Writing and AP exams, by the same closing date as other IB applicants.

faculties.name: Humanities and Sciences
faculties.line: Majors in the humanities, social sciences and sciences; check each programme's IB prerequisites.

notes: EU students can take the MOE Tuition Grant, which cuts the fee but requires you to work for a Singapore entity for three years after graduating.
Admission is holistic: academic merit, non-academic achievements and, for some programmes, interviews or tests, in open competition.
You must authorise the IB to release your transcript to NUS (institute code 000690) through your school's IB coordinator.
